name: Jarvis (Rahul)
author: h3man, themed by rahulj
description: Omarchy Jarvis (h3man.jarvis) restyled to this desktop: soft pills and cards like the notification bell. The bridge, launcher and service still run from the h3man.jarvis checkout.

barWidget.description: Shows whether the local voice bridge is online and opens a QR code that puts the JARVIS push-to-talk interface on your phone.
